subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Responds to positional language (on, next to, behind, in front of, under)

show.line: Where is the owl? On the branch. Under the moon. Next to the star. Let's play!

rounds.prompt: Which picture shows the cat on the roof?
rounds.praise: Yes! The cat is on the roof.

rounds.prompt: Tap the ball that is under the chair.
Where is the bird? On the moon, or next to the moon?
Which dog is behind the tree? You can only see its tail.
rounds.praise: Yes! The dog is hiding behind the tree.

rounds.prompt: Tap the girl who is in front of the house.

rounds.story: At night Owl sits on the branch. A star shines next to him. Where does Owl sit?
rounds.praise: Yes! Owl sits on the branch.

hints: On means on top. Under means below.
Behind means at the back. You cannot see it well.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say where the cat is.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The cat is under the roof!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The cat is on the roof, on top.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. The cat is on top of the roof. On!

parent_line: Can understand on, under, next to, behind and in front of.
